723	/****************************************************************************
724	 * Name: tun_txavail_work
725	 *
726	 * Description:
727	 *   Driver callback invoked when new TX data is available.  This is a
728	 *   stimulus perform an out-of-cycle poll and, thereby, reduce the TX
729	 *   latency.
730	 *
731	 * Input Parameters:
732	 *   dev - Reference to the NuttX driver state structure
733	 *
734	 * Returned Value:
735	 *   None
736	 *
737	 * Assumptions:
738	 *   Called in normal user mode
739	 *
740	 ****************************************************************************/
741	
742	static void tun_txavail_work(FAR void *arg)
743	{
744	  FAR struct tun_device_s *priv = (FAR struct tun_device_s *)arg;
745	  int ret;
746	
747	  ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
748	  if (ret < 0)
749	    {
750	      /* Thread has been canceled, skip poll-related work */
751	
752	      return;
753	    }
754	
755	  /* Check if there is room to hold another network packet. */
756	
757	  if (priv->read_d_len != 0)
758	    {
759	      nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
760	      return;
761	    }
762	
763	  net_lock();
764	  if (priv->bifup)
765	    {
766	      /* Poll the network for new XMIT data */
767	
768	      devif_poll(&priv->dev, tun_txpoll);
769	    }
770	
771	  net_unlock();
772	  nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
773	}

723	/****************************************************************************
724	 * Name: tun_txavail_work
725	 *
726	 * Description:
727	 *   Driver callback invoked when new TX data is available.  This is a
728	 *   stimulus perform an out-of-cycle poll and, thereby, reduce the TX
729	 *   latency.
730	 *
731	 * Input Parameters:
732	 *   dev - Reference to the NuttX driver state structure
733	 *
734	 * Returned Value:
735	 *   None
736	 *
737	 * Assumptions:
738	 *   Called in normal user mode
739	 *
740	 ****************************************************************************/
741	
742	static void tun_txavail_work(FAR void *arg)
743	{
744	  FAR struct tun_device_s *priv = (FAR struct tun_device_s *)arg;
745	  int ret;
746	
747	  ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
748	  if (ret < 0)
749	    {
750	      /* Thread has been canceled, skip poll-related work */
751	
752	      return;
753	    }
754	
755	  /* Check if there is room to hold another network packet. */
756	
757	  if (priv->read_d_len != 0)
758	    {
759	      nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
760	      return;
761	    }
762	
763	  net_lock();
764	  if (priv->bifup)
765	    {
766	      /* Poll the network for new XMIT data */
767	
768	      devif_poll(&priv->dev, tun_txpoll);
769	    }
770	
771	  net_unlock();
772	  nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
773	}

982	/****************************************************************************
983	 * Name: tun_write
984	 ****************************************************************************/
985	
986	static ssize_t tun_write(FAR struct file *filep, FAR const char *buffer,
987	                         size_t buflen)
988	{
989	  FAR struct tun_device_s *priv = filep->f_priv;
990	  uint8_t llhdrlen;
991	  ssize_t ret;
992	
993	  if (priv == NULL || buflen > CONFIG_NET_TUN_PKTSIZE)
994	    {
995	      return -EINVAL;
996	    }
997	
998	  llhdrlen = NET_LL_HDRLEN(&priv->dev);
999	
1000	  for (; ; )
1001	    {
1002	      /* Write must return immediately if interrupted by a signal (or if the
1003	       * thread is canceled) and no data has yet been written.
1004	       */
1005	
1006	      ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
1007	      if (ret < 0)
1008	        {
1009	          return ret;
1010	        }
1011	
1012	      if (!priv->bifup)
1013	        {
1014	          ret = -ENETDOWN;
1015	          break;
1016	        }
1017	
1018	      /* Check if there are free space to write */
1019	
1020	      if (priv->write_d_len == 0)
1021	        {
1022	          net_lock();
1023	          netdev_iob_release(&priv->dev);
1024	          ret = netdev_iob_prepare(&priv->dev, false, 0);
1025	          priv->dev.d_buf = NULL;
1026	          if (ret < 0)
1027	            {
1028	              net_unlock();
1029	              break;
1030	            }
1031	
1032	          ret = iob_trycopyin(priv->dev.d_iob, (FAR const uint8_t *)buffer,
1033	                              buflen, -llhdrlen, false);
1034	          if (ret < 0)
1035	            {
1036	              net_unlock();
1037	              break;
1038	            }
1039	
1040	          priv->dev.d_len = buflen;
1041	
1042	          tun_net_receive(priv);
1043	          net_unlock();
1044	
1045	          ret = buflen;
1046	          break;
1047	        }
1048	
1049	      /* Wait if there are no free space to write */
1050	
1051	      if ((filep->f_oflags & O_NONBLOCK) != 0)
1052	        {
1053	          ret = -EAGAIN;
1054	          break;
1055	        }
1056	
1057	      priv->write_wait = true;
1058	      nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
1059	      nxsem_wait(&priv->write_wait_sem);
1060	    }
1061	
1062	  nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
1063	  return ret;
1064	}
